source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Makes the bread partners intelligible while preserving the final third-person shift and obscure trap term.
Keeps prohibitive form rather than silently changing to past should-not-have and preserves day refrain.
Retains the three repeated disaster clauses and possession shifts.
Keeps interception and betrayal as separate actions against escapees.
Keeps shift to plural you and the ambiguous drinking image, not specifying celebratory or judgment drink in text.
Uses company for obscure hel and supplies land to the elliptical possession clause; leaves Sepharad unidentified.
Follows pointed active deliverers rather than rescued ones and preserves final divine kingship.
